The doctrine is based on the simple reasoning that there cannot be, at the same time, more than one governing order governing the same subject matter. Reliance is placed on the decision of the Hon’ble Supreme Court in **_Balbir Singh & Ors._** - (v) Accordingly, the Final Judgment passed by this Tribunal is the only order that governs the issue of the procurement of coal through alternate sources by NPL.
